steps.note: The workflow's command, `cite check "docs/**/*.md" -f github`: findings become workflow commands and the exit code drives the job.
Record the backlog once: `--write-baseline` prints `2 findings (2 baselined)` and writes the baseline file.
Make the PR job report-only: `--baseline` counts the backlog as baselined.
Verify: a change to a cited line makes the job red with a `manni:cite/source-changed` annotation.
Verify: lines added above a cited one leave it green with a `manni:cite/source-moved` warning.
Verify: a paragraph added above a cited sentence leaves it green with a `manni:cite/claim-moved` notice.
Verify: running `manni cite update` clears both.

scaffolding: docs/limits.md carries two citations of lib/limits.ts: fetch-timeout is current; retries has drifted (a comment line above its source line, a paragraph above its sentence), so the first run finds 2 findings (1 warning) (1 notice) for the baseline to record. manni.config.yaml declares the docs-pages collection over docs/**/*.md, so a bare `manni cite check` checks the page.

The entries' commit-sha names a commit outside the one-commit workspace history: a changed source reads `changed (history unavailable ...)`, still source-changed, as the page's Full history section describes. The verify scenarios are edits a spec makes itself.
